id.description: The id of the table in the Tyro Connect system

number.description: This value must be unique and represents the table number or table id. This field accepts alphanumeric characters e.g `MAIN-33`

locationId.description: The id of the location as specified by the Tyro Connect system

openSales.description: A list of sale ids that are open in the Tyro Connect system attached to the table.

id.description: The POS system's Id of the section

name.description: The readable name of the section. E.g. Front bar, drive through for hospitality or for retail men's clothes, women's shoes etc
